transcript:
Agent: Thank you for calling Card Member Services. My name is Marcus. How can I help you today?
Customer: Hi Marcus, I was looking over my card charges and there is a total here that I'm really upset about.
Agent: I can certainly take a look into that with you. First, may I have your full name and the billing zip code on the account?
Customer: Yes, my name is Patricia Lowell, and the zip code is 48201.
Agent: Thank you, Ms. Lowell. Which transaction are you calling about?
Customer: It's from Juniper & Vine Apparel on September 23rd, for $318.75.
Agent: I see that transaction on September 23rd for $318.75. Can you tell me a little more about what happened?
Customer: Well, I gave my teenage daughter my card to pick up a few back-to-school items, but she went completely overboard and spent way more than what we had talked about.
Agent: Did you provide her with the physical card to use at the store?
Customer: Yes, I handed it right to her before she left for the mall. She was supposed to get maybe two shirts and a pair of pants, definitely not over three hundred dollars.
Agent: Did she return the card to you after she finished shopping?
Customer: Yes, she gave it right back to me that evening, but I didn't realize the total until now.
Agent: Have you spoken to your daughter or contacted Juniper & Vine Apparel about returning any of the merchandise?
Customer: I confronted my daughter, but she already tore the tags off everything and refuses to take them back. I haven't reached out to the store.
Agent: Did anyone else have access to your card or participate in making this purchase?
Customer: No, nobody else. Just her using the card I gave her that afternoon.
Agent: Alright, Ms. Lowell, so just to make sure I have all the facts down: you handed your card to your daughter on September 23rd to shop for school clothes at Juniper & Vine Apparel, she completed the purchase for $318.75 which was more than you expected her to spend, and the card was returned to your possession that same day.
Customer: Yes, that is exactly what happened.
